note: v2.2 plan 07 Phase A. Each stub has three hand-written chains whose labels are defect categories: clean, contradicts (a beat breaks an established fact), wanders (the beats do not move toward the target). The two Spanish noir stubs went with v2.6 W25. Labels written before any judge answer was read.

facts: A sphinx guards the gate of the Sun Ruins.

target.name: Travel with Luke
target.objective: Reach the Sun Ruins with Luke and face the sphinx's riddle.

chains.label: clean
beats: Leave town at dawn with Luke and Arin.
Cross the dunes; Luke struggles in the heat and Arin shares her water.
Arrive at the ruins, where the sphinx waits at the gate with its riddle.

chains.label: contradicts
beats: Leave town at dawn while Luke stays home with their mother.
Cross the dunes with Arin alone.
Arrive at the ruins, where the sphinx waits at the gate.

chains.label: wanders
beats: Stop at a desert market to trade trinkets.
Spend three days gambling at a caravan camp.
Ride back toward town to buy new boots.

facts: The sphinx's riddle was answered wrong.
The front gate of the ruins collapsed.

target.name: Find the Artifact
target.objective: Recover the Sun's Heart Artifact from the inner chamber.

chains.label: clean
beats: Crawl through a side tunnel while Arin presses a cloth to her wound.
Dodge falling stones in the collapsing corridor.
Reach the inner chamber and see the Sun's Heart on its altar.

chains.label: contradicts
beats: The sphinx, pleased with their answer, opens the front gate for them.
Walk down the grand hall past painted columns.
Reach the inner chamber and see the Sun's Heart.

chains.label: wanders
beats: Camp outside the ruins for a week while Arin heals.
Hunt sand lizards for food.
Decide to go back to the guild empty-handed.

facts: Ponticius raised the reward to 500 crowns.

target.name: Return to the Guild
target.objective: Deliver the artifact to the Guild Master and claim your reward.

chains.label: clean
beats: Cross the desert home with the Sun's Heart wrapped in a cloak.
Enter the guild hall late at night.
Set the artifact on Ponticius's counter and collect the 500 crowns.

chains.label: contradicts
beats: Cross the desert home.
Enter the guild hall.
Accept the 250 crowns Ponticius first promised, since the reward never changed.

chains.label: wanders
beats: Sell the Sun's Heart to a stranger at an oasis.
Travel north to a different city.
Open a tavern with the money.

facts: Arin has distrusted Max since he lied about the map.
The Sun Ruins contract is signed.

target.name: Departure Preparations
target.objective: Decide whether to take Luke along before departing for the Sun Ruins.

chains.label: clean
beats: Pack supplies at home while Luke begs to come along.
Arin argues coldly with Max, still sore about the map lie.
Max decides whether Luke comes on the journey.

chains.label: contradicts
beats: Pack supplies while Arin says she trusts Max completely and always has.
Luke begs to come along.
Max decides whether Luke comes on the journey.

chains.label: wanders
beats: Spend the day fishing at the harbor.
Visit an old friend in the next town over.
Forget about the contract for a while.

facts: The ship's long-range antenna was torn off.
There are four escape pods on deck two.

target.name: Reach Kepler Station
target.objective: Bring the damaged ship into Kepler Station's repair dock.

chains.label: clean
beats: Okafor plots the course to Kepler Station.
The ship slips through an asteroid field on short-range sensors.
HALO hails Kepler on short range and they dock.

chains.label: contradicts
beats: HALO calls Kepler Station on long-range comms from three days out.
The ship crosses the asteroid field.
They dock at Kepler.

chains.label: wanders
beats: Stop to salvage a derelict freighter.
Land to explore an uncharted moon.
Turn around and head for Earth.

chains.label: clean
beats: Pell traces the fault to coolant loop two.
Max holds the valve while Pell bypasses the loop as the heat climbs.
The reactor settles and main power comes back.

chains.label: contradicts
beats: The reactor has been running perfectly all week, so Pell naps.
Max checks the logs.
Main power comes back on.

chains.label: wanders
beats: The crew throws a birthday party in the galley.
Max plays cards with HALO.
Everyone goes to sleep.

facts: The portraits move because of a mechanism Graves works from behind the walls.
Lady Ashworth is selling the house.

target.name: Confront Graves
target.objective: Make Graves admit why he scared off the buyers.

chains.label: clean
beats: Max finds the lever hidden behind the gallery wall.
Max waits for Graves in the servants' corridor.
Graves admits he wanted to keep the house in the family.

chains.label: contradicts
beats: At midnight a real ghost moves the portraits while everyone watches.
Max follows the ghost to the attic.
Graves admits he knew about the ghost.

chains.label: wanders
beats: Max tours the rose garden.
Max reads botany books in the library.
Max naps in the guest room.

facts: The family records were found in the library.
The estate carriage leaves at sunset.

target.name: Leave the Manor
target.objective: Pack and leave Ashworth Hall before nightfall.

chains.label: clean
beats: Max packs the family records into his bag.
Lady Ashworth gives a cold farewell in the hall.
Max boards the carriage at sunset.

chains.label: contradicts
beats: Max searches the house for the family records, which have never been found.
Lady Ashworth gives a cold farewell.
Max boards the carriage at sunset.

chains.label: wanders
beats: Max decides to stay another month.
Max helps Graves repaint the gallery.
Max misses the carriage on purpose.
